notes.title: v1.1 (April 20) HAPPY EASTER! Easter Update
notes.notes:
v1.10 (April 20th) 20 April (Happy Easter everyone!)

Version 1.1! From this point forward I'm not really sure if I should make a mini-announcement every single time I make a small tweak to the game, because it would probably clog up the game's Steam community tab... idk lol. 
- The manual is actually out now! Sorry that it wasn't available earlier but now it should be publicly viewable (still a work in progress, it'll improve as time goes on)
- Made secret achievement extra special when you hit the grand jackpot in Slots/Joker Poker
- Improved translations
- Linux version? yeah i know i still gotta do this... but idk man it'll come out eventually
- If you're reading this, please give this update post a THUMBS UP! (if you're cool!)
- You can now send a letter to Mr. Goofer in-game...

Okay... NOW is when I'd actually consider the game to be "fully complete". I know I released version 1.0 of the game back on Groundhog's Day, but... right now is when I'd actually consider the game to be a 100% finished work of art. 
Maybe I should've delayed the game? Yeah... I absolutely should have... I was an idiot. Now people's playthroughs of the game on YouTube and stuff are outdated... idk man. I learned a lot though.

but... OK! It's finally time to move onto other stuff! I have some exciting ideas and potential future projects planned... stay tuned! But honestly life has been a bit hard for me personally lately, so I'm not sure when these things will happen... but they'll happen eventually.

In the meantime, happy Easter! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hello players! + Linux version
notes.notes:
Hello people! And to those who just found my game from Keymailer, welcome! I hope you enjoy my game :)

Release date is next week... the game is basically finished lol. but (of course) I am still going to continue to make minor adjustments, add polish, and make small tweaks and fixes if necessary. Right now I'm actually waiting on Valve to approve the release build of my game. Then, as soon as they do — Mr. Goofer's will be RELEASED! (woooo! ːsteamhappyː)

If you're from Keymailer: Hopefully your access keys work well! — earlier there was a bit of an issue where the wrong type of key was being sent out to people, but now that should all be fixed up and your product activation codes should be able to be redeemed and it should be working properly. I really hope you like Mr. Goofer's! And if you play the game, PLEASE! upload gameplay or a video about it to YouTube, that would really help out a ton!!! Like, seriously. I look forward to seeing any content that is made about it and I'll try to watch all of them! :)

* Another important note — I want to let everyone know that the Windows version of the game will only be available by the initial launch date of the game, BUT don't worry Linux users, as I am currently typing this out I am downloading a virtual machine and installing Ubuntu onto my computer so that I can compile my game so that it supports Linux! The whole thing is a bit of a technical complicated process, but it shouldn't take too long. The version for Ubuntu will be available as soon as possible.

Thanks again, and I'll see you all on Groundhog Day! (Will the gopher see his shadow? 🤔)

notes.title: Getting Ready by Groundhog Day... Release Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you all had a great holiday season. (A little late, I know we're already three weeks into January...)

Mr. Goofer's will be releasing on FEBRUARY 2nd! That's very soon! Too soon, even for me. 

IMPORTANT note: I want to be clear that the game will only be available in English (and maybe Swedish) when it releases. HOWEVER, I will constantly update the game whenever I add a new language. Having to pay a bunch of translators takes a bit of time! But they will get added eventually.

The game drops on Groundhog Day - obviously, I will keep updating it, adding small tweaks, fixing up any potential bugs (although I playtested the game many times and haven't found any), fixing it up a little bit here and there. The leaderboards will be up and running, they're a bit hard to test out but they should be in good shape by release.

 Although the game is a bit ridiculous, I spent a lot of time making it and I really hope you guys enjoy it. As a solo developer, I can't do a million things at once lol. The stress has been kind of getting to me. I also realized I'm going to be releasing my first commercial video game while I'm still technically a teenager, (my birthday is the week after release!) so that's funny. 

If you've had my game wishlisted for a while, or whether you literally just found my game and you're completely new here, thank you!

(Hey... does anyone even read these announcements?)

notes.title: Release Date Update… COMING SOON
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I’d like to thank you for your patience as I finish up the development of “Mr. Goofer’s Mini Game Arcade Party!” and prepare it for release.

I’m sure as you may know, the release date I set for the game was Q4 2024. And the end of the year is approaching… so here’s an update.

The game itself is pretty much 99% content complete! So if I really wanted to, I could just honestly release it like mid-December before the holidays… Unfortunately though, I really need more time for polish, translation, emails, and a bunch of other stuff that’s boring but necessary, so I’m going to have to delay the game a little bit into 2025. I really am just one person, a solo dev so I’d rather just take my time. That being said, right now the game is going to be in an “open beta” stage as I provide access keys to play testers, as well as press outlets so that they hopefully like my game enough to write articles about it. Contact me if you’re interested in getting the inside scoop.

“So, what’s the new release date for Mr. Goofer’s now?!” You may be asking (or not)

GROUNDHOG DAY 2025! (Er, Gopher Day 2025!)
That’s right, Feb 2. (Which is actually 9 days before my birthday 🥹)

That’s very early next year, so stay tuned!

For more information, read this thread (and for more dumb posts follow me on Twitter): https://x.com/KeriSvinta/status/1857268532922159384
